newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-SIGEL WINS SENIOR TOURNAMENT BY SEVEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-SIGEL WINS SENIOR TOURNAMENT BY SEVEN.

text.p: Jay Sigel romped to victory in the $1 million Kroger Senior Classic on Sunday, firing a five-under-par 66 to win the event by seven strokes at the Golf Centre at Kings Island.
Sigel, winning for the second time this year on the Senior Tour, played the 54 holes in 18-under-par 195.
Sigel, who sandwiched a second-round 63 between a pair of 66s, collected a $150,000 top prize to boost his winnings this season to just under $800,000.
Defending champion Isao Aoki was second at 11-under while Dave Ojala, Larry Gilbert and John Jacobs finished two strokes further adrift.
